mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_embedding_model ( model_name, display_name, dimension, description, is_default, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{modelName}, #{displayName}, #{dimension}, #{description}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_embedding_model SET model_name = #{modelName}, display_name = #{displayName}, dimension = #{dimension}, description = #{description}, is_default = #{isDefault}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
